an6.103:1.1: 103 cha bhikkhave ānisaṃse sampassamānena alameva bhikkhunā sabbasaṃkhāresu anodhiṃ karitvā dukkhasaññaṃ upaṭṭhapetuṃ
an6.103:1.3: sabbasaṃkhāresu ca me nibbānasaññā paccupaṭṭhitā bhavissati seyyathāpi ukkhittāsike vadhake
an6.103:1.4: sabbalokā ca me mano vuṭṭhahissati nibbāne ca santidassāvī bhavissāmi anusayā ca me samugghātaṃ gacchissanti kiccakārī ca bhavissāmi satthā ca pariciṇṇo bhavissati mettāvatāyāti
an6.103:1.5: ime kho bhikkhave cha ānisaṃse sampassamānena alameva bhikkhunā sabbasaṃkhāresu anodhiṃ karitvā dukkhasaññaṃ upaṭṭhapetunti.
